WITH EQP_STATUS AS( SELECT EQP_ID,PREV_E10_STATE_CODE FROM
PWEB.EQP_ID_STATUS_DAILY@A1PDW
PWEB.EQP_ID_STATUS_DAILY@A3PDW

A1_MFG.RDS_MONITOR_DETAILS A
A1_MFG.A3_RDS_MONITOR_DETAILS A
)WHERE RN=1 )A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EQP_ID,PREV_E10_STATE_CODE FROM EQP_STATUS )B ON A.TOOLID||'.'||A.CHAMBERID = B.EQP_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EQP_ID,PREV_E10_STATE_CODE FROM EQP_STATUS )C ON A.TOOLID = C.EQP_ID )WHERE STATUS IN ('PRD','SBY') )GROUP BY ROLLUP(MODULE) ) ,PLAN_RATIO AS( SELECT NVL(MODULE,'TOTAL')MODULE ,CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN MODULE <> 'CMP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >0 THEN ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN MODULE <> 'CMP' AND ACTIVE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100/SUM(CASE WHEN MODULE <> 'CMP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),1) END RATIO ,COUNT(1) TOTAL_JOB_COUNT FROM( SELECT DISTINCT MODULE,JOBGROUPID ,TOOLID,ACTIVE FROM
A1_MFG.RDS_MONITOR_DETAILS A
A1_MFG.A3_RDS_MONITOR_DETAILS A
WHERE (MODULE <> 'DIFF' OR (MODULE ='DIFF' AND JOBGROUPID NOT LIKE '%5M%' AND JOBGROUPID NOT IN('IBVAs2NFilterBeamI','RDS-FUR','RNA N2 Process','RNA NO Process','RNA O2 Process') )) )GROUP BY ROLLUP(MODULE) ) SELECT A.*,B.RATIO,B.TOTAL_JOB_COUNT FROM REMAIN_RDS_INFO A LEFT JOIN PLAN_RATIO B ON A.MODULE = B.MODULE -- for 刘聪慧comment ,CMP 防止最后，Monitor Plan 显示为 - ORDER BY DECODE(A.MODULE,'PHOTO',1,'ETCH',2,'TF',3,'DIFF',4,'WET',5,'METRO',6,'CMP',7,8)

PWEB.EQP_ID_STATUS_DAILY@A3PDW
WHERE SHIFT_DATE= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') ) SELECT DKEY,TOOLID,CHAMBERID,MODULE,LIFETIME,EXPIRETIME,JOBGROUPID,JOBSPECID,EQP_G,TEST_FOR2 ,REMAIN_RDS,CLAIMUSER,LASTSTAMPTIME,RECIPE_MEMO,WIP,WIP_CLOSE_1D,WIP_CLOSE_3D,WIP_CLOSE_7D,STATUS ,CASE WHEN ACTIVE IS NULL THEN '不存在' WHEN ACTIVE ='0' AND TEST_FOR1='RT' THEN '未启用' WHEN ACTIVE ='1' AND TEST_FOR1='RT' THEN '已启用' WHEN TEST_FOR1<>'RT' THEN 'PM' END ACTIVE FROM( SELECT A.*,NVL(B.PREV_E10_STATE_CODE,C.PREV_E10_STATE_CODE)STATUS ,NVL(B.EQP_G,C.EQP_G)EQP_G FROM( SELECT A.* FROM( SELECT A.*,ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY DKEY ORDER BY EXPIRETIME )RN FROM

WHERE 1=1
AND TEST_FOR2 = #{testfor}
AND MODULE = #{module}
)A WHERE RN=1
AND REMAIN_RDS >= TO_NUMBER(#{remainRdsmin })
AND REMAIN_RDS < TO_NUMBER(#{remainRdsmax })
)A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EQP_ID,EQP_G,PREV_E10_STATE_CODE FROM EQP_STATUS )B ON A.TOOLID||'.'||A.CHAMBERID = B.EQP_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT EQP_ID,EQP_G,PREV_E10_STATE_CODE FROM EQP_STATUS )C ON A.TOOLID = C.EQP_ID )WHERE STATUS IN ('PRD','SBY')

SELECT KEY1 EQP_ID,KEY2 CHAMBER_ID,KEY3 EQP_G,KEY4 JOB_GROUP_ID,F_COMMENT,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME FROM A1_MFG.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'RDS_EQPG_BACKUP_JOBGROUP' ORDER BY KEY3,KEY1,KEY2,KEY4
